title: Triage 5 open-access candidates through both gates
context: Applies the access-tier + identifiability + license gate to five open-access candidate datasets, producing a committed gate artifact for each. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Depends on the gate, matrix, policy, and outreach shortlist; COSMIC/OncoKB never pass.
objective: Evaluate five open-access candidate datasets through both gates and commit a gate artifact (PASS/FLAG/EXCLUDE) for each, applying policy-006.
acceptanceCriteria: Five open-access datasets evaluated with a committed gate artifact each (access-tier first, then identifiability, then license), applying policy-006.
Each PASS records open-tier confirmation, identifiability result, license id/URL/snapshot, and permitsDerivatives: true with cited evidence.
Any controlled/identifiable/NC-or-unclear dataset is EXCLUDED/FLAGGED with the concern surfaced; COSMIC/OncoKB never pass.
